narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -0.93 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.03301-0.03452 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 0.03634; the first objective pays 1.61R at 0.03217.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 0.03301-0.03452
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.03634 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
